page_title: Aris — An AI agent for everything on your Mac

sources.entry: Aris - Open-source AI agent in the MacBook notch that you talk or type to, which acts in your apps with the AI you already use and asks before anything that sends, writes or deletes. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/LumenJSN/Aris) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Aris
summary.one_liner: Aris is a free, open-source AI agent for macOS that you talk or type to from the notch, and that acts in your apps using the AI model you already have.
keywords: voice to text in any app
use_cases: Talk or type requests to an AI agent that acts in your Mac apps
Dictate text into any text field with voice
Ask questions about anything on screen by circling it
Hand long coding or research jobs to Claude Code or other teammates
Review and approve messages, mail, or calendar changes before they send
Check timers, to-dos, calendar, and clipboard history from the notch
summary.what_it_does: Aris is a macOS agent that lives in the notch. You can hold Option+Space to talk or type a request, and it answers in a card and then performs the work in apps like Mail, Slack, Notes, and calendar. Holding Option and Shift while drawing around part of the screen lets you ask about that area. Long jobs can be handed to teammates, including Claude Code for code, and each reports back when done. Anything that sends, writes, or deletes is shown as a card for approval first. The page says it uses the AI you already have, with no Aris account or Aris server, and API keys are stored in the macOS Keychain.
notable: Open source, listed on GitHub at LumenJSN/Aris
Circle any part of the screen with Option+Shift to ask about it
Approval cards before messages, mail, calendar changes, or deletes
Bring-your-own-AI with optional local model so requests stay on the Mac
caveats: Not notarized yet; download only from GitHub Releases and verify SHA256SUMS
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later
Needs an AI provider or local model of your own; Aris does not supply one
